findings.title: Resolve cache-compilation symbols back to the solution before SymbolFinder in unused/dead-field/coupling analysis
findings.description: Resolve cache-compilation symbols back to the solution before SymbolFinder in unused/dead-field/coupling analysis. find_dead_fields(W_RO, projectName=RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio) → s_index/AnalysisTools/s_currentReleaseVersion usageKind=never-read, safelyRemovable=true; all three are read (PromptParameterIndex.cs:32, ServerSurfaceCatalog.cs:32, :105). Introduced by #1402 (92ac5a9c).
acceptance: find_dead_fields on a project with materialized generator output (RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio) no longer reports ServerSurfaceCatalog.s_allTools / PromptParameterIndex.s_index / s_currentReleaseVersion as never-read or safelyRemovable
find_unused_symbols no longer reports ServerSurfaceCatalog.Tool (100+ call sites) as unused
get_coupling_metrics reports non-zero Ca for Host.Stdio types referenced from other types
Regression test loads a fixture project with a source generator and asserts a referenced field is not reported dead
findings.suggested_approach: Fix generator-project blindness in unused-symbol, dead-field and coupling analysis — map symbols from the generator-rerun compilation back to the Solution before SymbolFinder so live code stops reporting zero references.

findings.title: find_type_consumers / find_type_mutations return empty for generator projects
findings.description: find_type_consumers / find_type_mutations return empty for generator projects. find_type_consumers(SurfaceEntry) → count 0 vs find_references totalCount 61; find_type_mutations(HostProcessMetadataStore) → mutatingMembers [] although WriteCurrent calls File.WriteAllText/Move/Delete.
acceptance: find_type_consumers(RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio.Catalog.SurfaceEntry) returns the consumers find_references/find_consumers report (61 refs / 13 types)
find_type_mutations(HostProcessMetadataStore) reports WriteCurrent with MutationScopes containing IO
Regression tests cover a generator-bearing fixture project
findings.suggested_approach: Fix find_type_consumers and find_type_mutations empty results in generator projects — resolve the type through the solution compilation instead of the cache's generator-rerun compilation.

findings.title: Unconfigured sanctioned roots surface as 'Parameter path is invalid'
findings.description: Unconfigured sanctioned roots surface as 'Parameter path is invalid'. Raw harness, server without roots env: workspace_load{path:<repo>/.../SampleSolution.slnx} → InvalidArgument "Parameter 'path' is invalid. Check that all required parameters are provided and values match the expected types."; cause only on stderr ('Filesystem boundary is not configured'). Reproduces on 4.2.1 and HEAD e24a48a4.
acceptance: With ROSLYNMCP_SANCTIONED_ROOTS unset (fail-closed), workspace_load on a valid absolute .slnx returns a message naming ROSLYNMCP_SANCTIONED_ROOTS / ROSLYNMCP_PATH_VALIDATION_FAIL_OPEN, not 'Parameter path is invalid … expected types'
The message does not echo the requested path (redaction contract preserved)
Regression test asserts the envelope message for the no-roots branch
findings.suggested_approach: Return an actionable error when no sanctioned roots are configured — throw a public, path-free message naming ROSLYNMCP_SANCTIONED_ROOTS instead of the generic 'Parameter path is invalid'.

findings.title: prompts/get rejects spec string args for int params and never names the bad argument
findings.description: prompts/get rejects spec string args for int params and never names the bad argument. prompts/get consumer_impact {line:"19",column:"21"} → -32602 Invalid parameters; same with JSON numbers → OK. prompts/get review_file {} → message never names filePath (PromptBindingStageAdapter.cs:73/85/90).
acceptance: prompts/get consumer_impact {line:"19",column:"21"} renders (MCP types prompt argument values as strings)
All 5 int-arg prompts (consumer_impact, explain_error, guided_extract_method, refactor_and_validate, suggest_refactoring) render with string args
Missing/invalid-arg errors name the parameter (e.g. "Missing required argument 'filePath' for prompt 'review_file'")
findings.suggested_approach: Accept spec-compliant string prompt arguments and name the offending argument — coerce string values for int/int? prompt params and include the parameter name in binding errors.

findings.title: split_service_with_di_preview facade deletes every other type in the file
findings.description: split_service_with_di_preview facade deletes every other type in the file. split_service_with_di_preview on G4Fixture.cs → facade diff deletes IG4Shape, G4Square, G4Circle, G4Point, G4Consumer and drops ': IG4Fixture' + const (not applied — data loss).
acceptance: Splitting a service whose file also declares other types/interfaces keeps those declarations, base list and constants intact
Preview output compiles (compile_check 0 new errors) for a multi-type source file
Regression test covers a file with an interface + 2 classes
findings.suggested_approach: Stop split_service_with_di_preview from deleting sibling types — rewrite the facade in place in the original compilation unit instead of emitting a fresh unit holding only the split class.

findings.title: change_signature_preview op=add skips later declarations/callsites in the same document
findings.description: change_signature_preview op=add skips later declarations/callsites in the same document. change_signature_preview op=add IG4Shape.Area → CS0535 on G4Square/G4Circle after apply; callsiteUpdates=1 of 5.
acceptance: op=add on an interface member whose implementations live in the same file updates every implementation (no CS0535)
callsiteUpdates equals find_references callsite count
Regression test: interface + 2 implementations + 3 callers in one file
findings.suggested_approach: Make change_signature_preview op=add update every implementation and callsite in a shared document — track spans against the edited tree (or batch edits per document) so later nodes are not skipped.

findings.title: restructure_preview splices captures without parentheses (silent semantic change)
findings.description: restructure_preview splices captures without parentheses (silent semantic change). `__a__ + 1` → `__a__ * 3` produced `count + count * 3` (compiles clean, wrong semantics). PlaceholderSubstituter.VisitIdentifierName returns captured.WithTriviaFrom(node) with no parenthesization.
acceptance: Pattern `__a__ + 1` → goal `__a__ * 3` applied to `count + 1` style input where __a__ binds a binary expression yields a parenthesized result
Regression test asserts precedence is preserved for binary/conditional captures
findings.suggested_approach: Parenthesize captured expressions when restructure_preview substitutes placeholders — wrap captures where operator precedence could change meaning so rewrites never silently alter semantics.

findings.title: replace_invocation_preview rewrites calls inside the replacement method (infinite recursion)
findings.description: replace_invocation_preview rewrites calls inside the replacement method (infinite recursion). replace_invocation_preview → SummarizeV2 body becomes SummarizeV2(verbose,title,count): infinite recursion, 0 diagnostics (reverted).
acceptance: Replacing Summarize(...) with SummarizeV2(...) where SummarizeV2 delegates to Summarize leaves SummarizeV2's body unchanged
Regression test asserts no callsite inside the replacement symbol is rewritten
findings.suggested_approach: Exclude the replacement method's own body from replace_invocation_preview — skip callsites inside the new target so the rewrite cannot create self-recursion.

findings.title: apply_composite_preview applies are not undoable; revert_last_apply undoes the previous op
findings.description: apply_composite_preview applies are not undoable; revert_last_apply undoes the previous op. revert_last_apply after composite seq37 reverted seq36 create_file instead. CompositeApplyOrchestrator has no CaptureBeforeApply call (only EditorConfigService, EditService, ProjectMutationService, RefactoringService do).
acceptance: revert_last_apply immediately after apply_composite_preview restores the composite's files
It does not touch the previous apply
workspace_changes records the composite apply
findings.suggested_approach: Capture undo state in CompositeApplyOrchestrator — call UndoService.CaptureBeforeApply so revert_last_apply reverts the composite apply, not the unrelated operation before it.

findings.title: change_type_namespace_preview emits uncompilable namespace syntax
findings.description: change_type_namespace_preview emits uncompilable namespace syntax. change_type_namespace_preview emits 'namespaceSampleLib.Shapes{'; apply_with_verify → 8 errors, rolled back.
acceptance: Preview on a file-scoped-namespace file produces compilable output (apply_with_verify status=applied)
Regression test covers file-scoped and block-scoped sources
findings.suggested_approach: Emit valid namespace syntax in change_type_namespace_preview — normalize the new block namespace and match the file's file-scoped style instead of splicing 'namespaceX{' beside a file-scoped namespace.

findings.title: Server-authored ArgumentException messages are redacted to a generic template
findings.description: Server-authored ArgumentException messages are redacted to a generic template. symbol_search{limit:-3} → "Parameter '<unknown>' is invalid…"; analyze_snippet bogus kind same; ValidatePagination (17 callers) throws paramless ArgumentException; 18 single-line paramless throws repo-wide. go_to_definition(line=99999)/enclosing_symbol(line=0) → "Parameter 'line' is invalid…" without the file line count.
acceptance: symbol_search{limit:-3} → message names 'limit' and the valid range
analyze_snippet{kind:'bogusKind'} names the valid kinds
evaluate_csharp{timeoutSeconds:-1} states 'must be greater than 0'
An analyzer or test guards against new plain `throw new ArgumentException(msg)` without paramName in Host.Stdio tool paths
findings.suggested_approach: Throw PublicArgumentException with a parameter name from ParameterValidation — out-of-range offset/limit errors must name the parameter and bound instead of "Parameter '<unknown>' is invalid".

findings.title: Actionable InvalidOperationException messages redacted to 'operation is not valid in the current state'
findings.description: Actionable InvalidOperationException messages redacted to 'operation is not valid in the current state'. 12 refusal paths across Phases 6/10/12/13 returned "The operation is not valid in the current state. Check the tool contract and retry." (set_project_property_preview, move_type_to_project_preview, create_file_preview existing file, scaffold_first_test_file_preview, format_range_preview, change_signature reorder, get_prompt_text unknown prompt, catalog-diff pair). Also misleading advice: build_project/test_run(projectName=NoSuchProject) and rename_preview(fabricated symbolHandle) → "The operation is not valid for the current workspace state. Call workspace_reload if the state is stale, then retry." (real cause: project/symbol not found, WorkspaceProjectResolver.cs:21).
acceptance: set_project_property_preview(OutputPath) returns 'Property OutputPath is not supported. Allowed properties: …'
move_type_to_project_preview cycle refusal names the cycle
format_range_preview refusal and change_signature reorder errors state the reason
get_prompt_text unknown prompt lists available prompts (PromptShimTools.cs:67)
build_project/test_run with an unknown projectName name the loaded projects and never advise workspace_reload
findings.suggested_approach: Carry public messages for expected InvalidOperation refusals — introduce a public-message exception for server-authored refusals (cycle, allowlist, duplicate ref, existing file) so ToolErrorHandler stops genericizing them.

findings.title: workspace_close publishes test seams getProcessesByName / processDrainTimeout
findings.description: workspace_close publishes test seams getProcessesByName / processDrainTimeout. tools/list: getProcessesByName {"$comment":"Unsupported .NET type","not":true}, processDrainTimeout {TimeSpan pattern}, both undocumented; comment at WorkspaceTools.cs:141 claims 'no [Description], so the schema omits it' — false. Client-settable drain timeout.
acceptance: tools/list workspace_close inputSchema has only workspaceId and drainProcesses
WorkspaceCloseDrainTests still inject a fake enumerator and short timeout via an internal overload
A schema test asserts no tool exposes a param with $comment 'Unsupported .NET type' or without a description
findings.suggested_approach: Remove test seams from the workspace_close MCP schema — move getProcessesByName/processDrainTimeout off the tool method so clients cannot see or set them.

findings.title: Misspelled/unknown tool arguments are silently ignored
findings.description: Misspelled/unknown tool arguments are silently ignored. 175/175 inputSchemas lack additionalProperties:false; compile_check{…,severty:'Error'} and workspace_status{…,__bogus:1} succeed; the filter is silently dropped.
acceptance: compile_check{workspaceId, severty:'Error'} returns InvalidArgument naming 'severty' and suggesting 'severity' (or succeeds with an explicit unknownArguments warning)
inputSchema advertises additionalProperties:false if rejection is chosen
Regression test covers one read and one write tool
findings.suggested_approach: Reject or warn on unknown tool arguments — fail with the list of accepted names (or add a _meta warning) so a typo like 'severty' no longer silently drops a filter.

findings.title: find_implementations(IDisposable) returns 0 even source-anchored (regression)
findings.description: find_implementations(IDisposable) returns 0 even source-anchored (regression). find_implementations(WorkspaceManager.cs:22:59 IDisposable) → count 0 + hint 'Source-anchor the query instead'. Prior audit 2026-05-31 (find-implementations-corlib-metadataname-zero): source-anchored returned 17 — now 0.
acceptance: find_implementations at a source position on an IDisposable token returns the workspace's implementers (26 by rg in W_RO)
The metadataName path either returns them too or its hint points at a path that works
Regression test pins both locator kinds
findings.suggested_approach: Let source-anchored find_implementations bypass the corlib-root guard — the hint tells callers to source-anchor, but that path also short-circuits to 0.

findings.title: get_di_registrations reports a constructor argument as the implementation type of factory lambdas
findings.description: get_di_registrations reports a constructor argument as the implementation type of factory lambdas. ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:87 → implementationType 'System.Net.Http.IHttpClientFactory'; :97 → 'ILogger<WorkspaceCacheStore>'.
acceptance: AddSingleton(sp => new NuGetVersionChecker(sp.GetRequiredService<IHttpClientFactory>(), …)) reports NuGetVersionChecker
Doc comment at :525 corrected
Regression test covers ctor-arg and forward (sp => sp.GetRequiredService<T>()) shapes
findings.suggested_approach: Resolve factory-lambda implementation types from the created object — use the object-creation type or a directly returned forward instead of the first nested GetRequiredService<T>.

findings.title: find_duplicate_helpers flags work-doing call chains as BCL re-wraps
findings.description: find_duplicate_helpers flags work-doing call chains as BCL re-wraps. ≥5 of 10 spot-checked hits (BuildEntries, FormatIdentityDrift, AppendRow, FormatVersionCheckStatus…) are false positives, all confidence=high.
acceptance: BuildEntries => GetParameters().Where().Select().ToArray() is not reported
A true re-wrap (x => Enumerable.ToArray(x)) still is
False-positive rate on the 10-sample spot check ≤ 10%
findings.suggested_approach: Require parameter forwarding before find_duplicate_helpers reports a re-wrap — check the outermost call only forwards the helper's parameters instead of classifying by outermost invocation.

findings.title: get_coupling_metrics summary counts only the returned page
findings.description: get_coupling_metrics summary counts only the returned page. summary=true → totalTypes=100, projectCount=3, Core absent; limit=5000 → 1504 types, 6 projects.
acceptance: summary=true (default limit 100) reports totalTypes 1504 and 6 projects on W_RO
Regression test with limit < type count
findings.suggested_approach: Compute get_coupling_metrics project rollups over all types — aggregate before applying limit so summary totals are not silently truncated to the top-N page.

findings.title: Unknown projectName returns empty results instead of an error
findings.description: Unknown projectName returns empty results instead of an error. project_diagnostics(projectName=NoSuchProject, summary) → all zeros; compile_check same input → InvalidArgument.
acceptance: project_diagnostics(projectName=NoSuchProject) → InvalidArgument naming the loaded projects
list_analyzers same
Regression test
findings.suggested_approach: Reject unknown projectName in project_diagnostics and list_analyzers — reuse compile_check's 'No loaded project matches' error so a typo does not read as a clean project.

findings.title: find_dead_locals flags outer locals captured and written by a local function
findings.description: find_dead_locals flags outer locals captured and written by a local function. 4 of 5 hits are false positives: outer local captured by a local function (containingMethod=ObservingHandler).
acceptance: WorkspaceReloadedEventTests.cs:60 'observed' is not reported
Regression test with a local function writing a captured outer local later read by the outer method
findings.suggested_approach: Skip outer locals in find_dead_locals' per-local-function data-flow pass — only report locals whose ContainingSymbol is the analyzed body owner.

findings.title: callers_callees drops callers in field/property initializers
findings.description: callers_callees drops callers in field/property initializers. callers_callees(Tool 434:33) → totalCallers 0 vs find_references 175; impact_analysis 175 refs / 0 affected declarations.
acceptance: callers_callees(ServerSurfaceCatalog.Tool) reports the initializer callers (find_references: 175)
find_references containingMember is non-null for initializer refs
impact_analysis affected declarations > 0 for Tool
findings.suggested_approach: Resolve the containing symbol of field initializers via the declarator — GetDeclaredSymbol(FieldDeclarationSyntax) returns null, so callers_callees and impact_analysis lose every initializer caller.

findings.title: analyze_data_flow / analyze_control_flow silently analyze a narrower range
findings.description: analyze_data_flow / analyze_control_flow silently analyze a narrower range. analyze_control_flow(MutationAnalysisService.cs 667-725) → analyzed only 711-725 (next method); returns 672/675 dropped, no warning.
acceptance: A range spanning two methods returns a warning + effective range (or InvalidArgument)
Single-method ranges unchanged
Regression test
findings.suggested_approach: Report the effective range (or refuse) when flow analysis narrows a multi-member selection — add effectiveStartLine/EndLine plus a warning instead of silently analyzing the largest block.

findings.title: build/test tool failures are returned as successful results
findings.description: build/test tool failures are returned as successful results. test_related(filePath,line) → {"error":true,"category":"InvalidArgument"…} delivered with isError=false; symbol_info same error → isError=true.
acceptance: test_related / build_workspace / build_project / test_discover / test_run / test_related_files error paths return isError=true
Regression test asserts isError on one induced failure per tool family
findings.suggested_approach: Set isError on build/test tool failure envelopes — route ValidationTools' catch-all through StructuredResultProjector.BuildErrorResult so clients see a failed call.

findings.title: fix_all_preview cannot find code-fix providers shipped in analyzer assemblies
findings.description: fix_all_preview cannot find code-fix providers shipped in analyzer assemblies. fix_all_preview CA1822/MSTEST0046 → 'No code fix provider' while code_fix_preview on the same diagnostic succeeds. AnalyzerFileReference.Display is a simple name, not a path.
acceptance: fix_all_preview(diagnosticId=CA1822) finds MarkMembersAsStaticCodeFix (code_fix_preview already does)
Regression test with an analyzer-package diagnostic
findings.suggested_approach: Load fix-all providers from analyzer references by full path — replace Assembly.LoadFrom(afr.Display) with the FullPath/GetAssembly route the code-fix registry uses.

findings.title: format_range_preview refuses whenever whole-document formatting changes line count anywhere
findings.description: format_range_preview refuses whenever whole-document formatting changes line count anywhere. format_range_preview range 60-80 refused because of a blank line at line 8.
acceptance: format_range_preview(60-80) succeeds when an unrelated blank line at line 8 would be removed by full-document format
Edits stay inside the requested range
Regression test
findings.suggested_approach: Format only the requested span in format_range_preview — use Formatter.FormatAsync with the span instead of splicing a whole-document format that refuses on unrelated line-count changes.

findings.title: extract_type_preview breaks interface contracts, publicizes fields, reformats whole file
findings.description: extract_type_preview breaks interface contracts, publicizes fields, reformats whole file. extract_type_preview moving Lookup → CS0535; fields made public; whole file NormalizeWhitespace'd.
acceptance: Moving a member that implements an interface is refused or leaves a forwarder (no CS0535)
Private fields stay private (:1024)
Unchanged regions are not reformatted (no whole-file NormalizeWhitespace)
findings.suggested_approach: Guard extract_type_preview against moving interface members and preserve accessibility — refuse (or keep a forwarder for) interface-implementing members, keep field accessibility, format only changed nodes.

findings.title: set_diagnostic_severity / set_editorconfig_option writes are not reflected until manual reload
findings.description: set_diagnostic_severity / set_editorconfig_option writes are not reflected until manual reload. CA1861 still Info after set_diagnostic_severity silent; isStale=false.
acceptance: After set_diagnostic_severity(CA1861, silent), project_diagnostics no longer reports CA1861 without a manual workspace_reload
workspace_status isStale=true (or version bumped) after the write
findings.suggested_approach: Invalidate the workspace after editorconfig writes — mark the workspace stale (or update AnalyzerConfigDocuments) so the next diagnostic call honors the new severity.

findings.title: extract_method_preview emits string? return that trips CS8603
findings.description: extract_method_preview emits string? return that trips CS8603. extract_method_preview → private string? BuildLine → CS8603 after apply.
acceptance: Extracting a region returning a non-null var string yields 'string' (no CS8603)
Regression test with nullable context enabled
findings.suggested_approach: Use the returned expression's flow state for extract_method's return type — use the nullable flow state of the returned value, not the var local's declared annotation.

findings.title: replace_string_literals_preview rewrites the target const's own initializer
findings.description: replace_string_literals_preview rewrites the target const's own initializer. const ReportPrefix = G4Fixture.ReportPrefix (CS0110) after preview.
acceptance: Replacing "report:" with G4Fixture.ReportPrefix leaves the const declaration unchanged
Regression test
findings.suggested_approach: Skip the target constant's own initializer in replace_string_literals_preview — the rewrite currently produces `const X = Type.X` (CS0110).

findings.title: record_field_add_with_satellites_preview inserts satellite lines outside initializers
findings.description: record_field_add_with_satellites_preview inserts satellite lines outside initializers. 'Evictions = this.Evictions,' inserted after the one-line Clone → CS1519 (reverted).
acceptance: A one-line Clone() => new(){…} gets the new member inside the initializer (no CS1519)
Snapshot/Reset satellites are updated
Regression test
findings.suggested_approach: Insert satellite updates syntactically in record_field_add_with_satellites_preview — edit the object initializer node instead of line-based insertion, and cover Snapshot/Reset satellites.

findings.title: Apply tools report 'workspace reloaded' for tokens from the other preview store
findings.description: Apply tools report 'workspace reloaded' for tokens from the other preview store. scaffold_test_batch_preview token → apply_composite_preview 'PreviewTokenStale: workspace was reloaded'; same token → preview_multi_file_edit_apply succeeds (3 files). symbol_refactor token → preview_multi_file_edit_apply reported 'reloaded'. Consumed token: rename_apply(token) twice → 2nd call "expired because the workspace was reloaded" (it was consumed).
acceptance: apply_composite_preview(<scaffold_test_batch token>) either applies it or names preview_multi_file_edit_apply
workspace_fork_apply accepts project-mutation tokens or its description drops 'any *_preview'
Descriptions of scaffold_test_batch_preview, dependency_inversion_preview, extract_interface_cross_project_preview, move_type_to_project_preview, symbol_refactor_preview name their apply tool
Re-applying a consumed token says the token was already applied, not that the workspace reloaded
findings.suggested_approach: Route preview tokens to the right store and document each preview's apply tool — a token from the wrong store must say 'redeem with <tool>' instead of a false 'workspace was reloaded'.

findings.title: migrate_package / remove_central_package_version drop PackageVersion entries other projects need
findings.description: migrate_package / remove_central_package_version drop PackageVersion entries other projects need. migrate_package_preview diff removes <PackageVersion Include="MSTest.TestAdapter"> from <repo>/Directory.Packages.props although tests/RoslynMcp.Tests and 2 more csproj reference it; warnings:null.
acceptance: migrate_package_preview(MSTest.TestAdapter→X) on the sample workspace keeps the central entry (or emits a warning naming tests/RoslynMcp.Tests)
remove_central_package_version_preview same
Regression test with an out-of-workspace consumer
findings.suggested_approach: Keep shared central PackageVersion entries when projects outside the workspace consume them — scan sibling project files under the Directory.Packages.props root, or warn, before removing.

findings.title: build_project reports errorCount 0 for project-level NU/MSB errors
findings.description: build_project reports errorCount 0 for project-level NU/MSB errors. build_project(SampleLib.Tests) → exitCode 1, stdout 'SampleLib.Tests.csproj : error NU1201: …', errorCount 0, diagnostics [].
acceptance: build_project on a project failing with NU1201 reports errorCount ≥1 with the diagnostic id
Regression test with a captured NU1201 output line
findings.suggested_approach: Parse location-less MSBuild/NuGet errors in DotnetOutputParser — accept 'project.csproj : error NU1201: …' lines so a failed build never reports errorCount 0.

findings.title: NetAnalyzers package + SDK built-in analyzers both run (every CA diagnostic reported twice)
findings.description: NetAnalyzers package + SDK built-in analyzers both run (every CA diagnostic reported twice). csc SARIF build of SampleLib: 74 results / 38 distinct; CA1822 64 = 32 unique ×2; list_analyzers 10 analyzers vs 6 assemblies. Package 10.0.401 ships no build/ props to disable the SDK copy (EnableNETAnalyzers defaults true).
acceptance: Only one NetAnalyzers copy is loaded (list_analyzers analyzer count drops; csc SARIF has no duplicate CA results)
project_diagnostics CA counts halve (e.g. CA1822 64 → 32 on the sample)
CI analyzer severity gates still pass
findings.suggested_approach: Drop the redundant Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers package reference — the SDK already injects the identical 10.0.401 analyzers, so every CA diagnostic is reported twice.

findings.title: Server runs duplicate analyzer assemblies twice
findings.description: Server runs duplicate analyzer assemblies twice. CA1822 reported 64 times for 32 unique occurrences on the sample solution.
acceptance: A project referencing the same analyzer assembly twice reports each diagnostic once
Regression test
findings.suggested_approach: Dedupe analyzer references by assembly identity in CompilationCache — duplicate analyzer DLLs (SDK + package) currently double every diagnostic the server reports.

findings.title: initialize advertises logging capability but server_info says logging:false
findings.description: initialize advertises logging capability but server_info says logging:false. initialize → capabilities.logging {}; logging/setLevel → {} success; server_info capabilities.logging=false; no notifications/message observed.
acceptance: initialize.capabilities.logging and server_info.capabilities.logging agree
If advertised, logging/setLevel changes what is emitted
findings.suggested_approach: Align the logging capability between initialize and server_info — either emit notifications/message or stop advertising capabilities.logging.

findings.title: nuget_vulnerability_scan annotated openWorldHint=false despite network access
findings.description: nuget_vulnerability_scan annotated openWorldHint=false despite network access. annotations openWorldHint=false; tool shells `dotnet list package --vulnerable` against NuGet. No tool in the 174-tool surface sets openWorldHint=true.
acceptance: tools/list nuget_vulnerability_scan annotations.openWorldHint=true
Catalog/annotation parity test still passes
findings.suggested_approach: Set OpenWorld=true on nuget_vulnerability_scan — it queries NuGet feeds; audit other network-touching tools for the same annotation.

findings.title: Catalog paging resources clamp invalid offset/limit instead of erroring
findings.description: Catalog paging resources clamp invalid offset/limit instead of erroring. catalog/tools/-1/0 → OK offset 0 limit 1; catalog/tools/0/999 → limit 200; catalog/tools/abc → generic redacted error.
acceptance: roslyn://server/catalog/tools/-1/0 → -32602 naming offset/limit
…/tools/abc/5 names 'offset must be an integer'
findings.suggested_approach: Reject out-of-range catalog page slots — negative offset or limit outside 1-200 should return InvalidArgument like tool-side ValidatePagination, not a silently clamped page.

findings.title: catalog-diff description advertises a version pair that is rejected
findings.description: catalog-diff description advertises a version pair that is rejected. catalog-diff/v2.3.1/v2.3.2 → 'Unsupported catalog diff. Request one of the version pairs advertised by the catalog resource.' — the catalog lists no pairs; only 2.3.1→current/latest works.
acceptance: Every pair named in the resource description resolves
The InvalidArgument message names the supported pairs
findings.suggested_approach: Make catalog-diff advertise only accepted pairs — fix the description's 'v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2' example, list supported pairs in the catalog, and surface the valid pair in the error.

findings.title: Only 8 of 175 tools declare outputSchema / structuredContent
findings.description: Only 8 of 175 tools declare outputSchema / structuredContent. tools/list: outputSchema on 8 tools (server_*, workspace_* status family), all 8 validate clean; 167 return JSON as text only.
acceptance: The named tools declare outputSchema and return structuredContent that validates
Schema drift test covers them
findings.suggested_approach: Add outputSchema + structuredContent to the high-traffic read tools — start with symbol_search, find_references, compile_check and project_diagnostics.

findings.title: get_source_text NotFound does not say the file isn't in the workspace
findings.description: get_source_text NotFound does not say the file isn't in the workspace. get_source_text nonexistent path → "The requested item was not found. Ensure the workspace is loaded and the identifier is correct."
acceptance: get_source_text{filePath:'C:/nonexistent/x.cs'} names the file-not-in-workspace cause
Path traversal inputs still reveal nothing about the host filesystem
findings.suggested_approach: Return a file-specific NotFound for get_source_text and location-based lookups — say the path is not a document in the loaded workspace instead of the generic identifier message.

findings.title: get_di_registrations omits TryAdd* but reports totalCountMeaning=complete
findings.description: get_di_registrations omits TryAdd* but reports totalCountMeaning=complete. get_di_registrations(Host.Stdio) → 14, totalCountMeaning 'complete'; source has 17.
acceptance: Host.Stdio count matches source (17 incl. TryAddSingleton at ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:80-82) or totalCountMeaning != complete
Schema text mentions the behavior
findings.suggested_approach: Include TryAdd* registrations (or report partial) in get_di_registrations — the default view drops them while claiming completeness.

findings.title: semantic_grep comment-scope hits report trivia start, not match position
findings.description: semantic_grep comment-scope hits report trivia start, not match position. semantic_grep('TODO|FIXME', scope=comments) → RecordFieldAdditionImpactDto.cs line 64 col 4; actual TODO at line 70, not in snippet.
acceptance: TODO at line 70 inside a doc comment starting at line 64 reports line 70 with the TODO in the snippet
findings.suggested_approach: Report the match offset for semantic_grep comment hits — return the matched line/column and snippet instead of the trivia start and its first 200 chars.

findings.title: schemaHint first-sentence trim cuts 'e.g.' and drops constraints
findings.description: schemaHint first-sentence trim cuts 'e.g.' and drops constraints. recommend_workflow(task='') → schemaHint '…Natural-language task, e.g)'.
acceptance: recommend_workflow(task='') schemaHint contains the full example
evaluate_csharp hint keeps 'Must be > 0'
findings.suggested_approach: Stop TrimToFirstSentence from splitting on abbreviations — treat 'e.g.'/'i.e.' as non-terminal and keep constraint sentences like 'Must be > 0'.

findings.title: analyze_snippet declaredSymbols omits fields, enums, events, ctors
findings.description: analyze_snippet declaredSymbols omits fields, enums, events, ctors. analyze_snippet(kind=members) → CS0414 on _name but declaredSymbols lacks it.
acceptance: kind=members snippet with `private string _name` lists the field
Enums/events/ctors listed
findings.suggested_approach: Collect field variables and other member kinds in analyze_snippet declaredSymbols — walk FieldDeclaration.Declaration.Variables and include enums, delegates, events, constructors.

findings.title: source_generated_documents conflates MSBuild .g.cs with generator output and lacks _meta
findings.description: source_generated_documents conflates MSBuild .g.cs with generator output and lacks _meta. source_generated_documents(W_RW) → bare array of 3 GlobalUsings.g.cs (MSBuild), no _meta.
acceptance: GlobalUsings.g.cs entries carry origin=msbuild (or are excluded)
Response is an object with _meta
findings.suggested_approach: Tag source_generated_documents entries by origin and wrap in an envelope — distinguish generator output from obj//*.g.cs MSBuild files and return an object so _meta is injected.

findings.title: discover_capabilities returns the full surface for an unknown category
findings.description: discover_capabilities returns the full surface for an unknown category. discover_capabilities{taskCategory:'nonsense-category'} → 'capabilities relevant to nonsense-category: Tools (174)…'.
acceptance: taskCategory='nonsense' lists valid categories
Rendered text no longer claims every tool needs a workspaceId
findings.suggested_approach: Reject or flag unknown taskCategory in discover_capabilities — replace the `_ => true` fallback and fix the false 'All tools require a workspaceId' line.

findings.title: roslyn://workspace/{id}/status/verbose lacks readiness fields the summary has
findings.description: roslyn://workspace/{id}/status/verbose lacks readiness fields the summary has. status has isReady/analyzersReady/restoreHint/solutionFileName/workspaceErrorCount; status/verbose has none of them.
acceptance: status/verbose keys ⊇ status keys
findings.suggested_approach: Make status/verbose a superset of status — include isReady, analyzersReady, restoreHint, solutionFileName and error counts in the verbose resource.

findings.title: analyze_dependencies prompt keeps 50 low-value external nodes
findings.description: analyze_dependencies prompt keeps 50 low-value external nodes. Rendered nodes = 50 external namespaces (typeCount 0); RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio.Tools appears in cycles but not nodes.
acceptance: Rendered prompt includes every namespace that appears in the cycles list
External namespaces with typeCount 0 rank last
findings.suggested_approach: Rank analyze_dependencies prompt nodes before capping — prefer project namespaces and cycle members over zero-type external namespaces.

findings.title: get_prompt_text description cites a nonexistent list_prompts
findings.description: get_prompt_text description cites a nonexistent list_prompts. promptName description: 'Use list_prompts on the resources channel…'.
acceptance: Descriptions at :47 and :57 name prompts/list or roslyn://server/catalog/prompts/{offset}/{limit}
findings.suggested_approach: Fix get_prompt_text's description to reference prompts/list — 'list_prompts' is neither a tool nor a resource.

findings.title: project_diagnostics cold scan 25 s and default page ~190 KB
findings.description: project_diagnostics cold scan 25 s and default page ~190 KB. project_diagnostics(limit=20) cold elapsedMs=24902 (budget 15 s); default limit=200 ≈190 KB; diagnostics resource cold 19.3 s.
acceptance: Default response < 100 KB on the 905-doc solution
Cold elapsed documented or reduced below 15 s
findings.suggested_approach: Cut project_diagnostics cold cost and default payload — lower the default limit or default to summary so the first call stays within budget and under 100 KB.

findings.title: get_namespace_dependencies circularOnly returns edges not on any cycle
findings.description: get_namespace_dependencies circularOnly returns edges not on any cycle. circularOnly=true returns Host.Stdio.Tools→Core.Models (34), which is on no cycle.
acceptance: circularOnly=true returns only edges within a strongly connected component
findings.suggested_approach: Filter circularOnly by edge-on-cycle, not endpoint-in-cycle — Tools→Core.Models is returned although it is on no cycle.

findings.title: diagnostic_details returns the raw MessageFormat with {0}
findings.description: diagnostic_details returns the raw MessageFormat with {0}. CS0414 → description "The field '{0}' is assigned but its value is never used".
acceptance: CS0414 description names the field
findings.suggested_approach: Format diagnostic_details description with the diagnostic's arguments — prefer diagnostic.GetMessage() before falling back to the descriptor MessageFormat.

findings.title: test_related finds no tests for private members
findings.description: test_related finds no tests for private members. test_related(ClassifyValueTypeMutation 498:28) → 0; test_related(ParameterObjectService) → 45.
acceptance: test_related(ParameterObjectService.ClassifyValueTypeMutation) returns the type's related tests (45)
findings.suggested_approach: Fall back to the containing type's tests in test_related for private/internal members — the member-only sweep never leaves its own file.

findings.title: trace_exception_flow ranks catch(Exception) equal to nearer base catches
findings.description: trace_exception_flow ranks catch(Exception) equal to nearer base catches. trace(PublicInvalidOperationException, max 5) → 5× catch(System.Exception) although 9 catch(InvalidOperationException) sites exist. Prior trace-exception-flow-no-throwsite-half partially fixed (throw sites now present).
acceptance: trace(PublicInvalidOperationException) lists catch(InvalidOperationException) sites before catch(Exception)
countOmitted reported per list
findings.suggested_approach: Rank trace_exception_flow catches by inheritance distance — nearer base-type catches must outrank catch(Exception); split countOmitted per list.

findings.title: callers_callees counts doc-comment cref references as callers
findings.description: callers_callees counts doc-comment cref references as callers. callers include `<see cref="GetCompilationAsync"/>` at ICompilationCache.cs:32,101.
acceptance: callers of ICompilationCache.GetCompilationAsync exclude ICompilationCache.cs:32,101 crefs
findings.suggested_approach: Exclude doc-comment cref references from callers_callees — filter references inside documentation trivia.

findings.title: find_type_consumers truncates without totalCount/hasMore
findings.description: find_type_consumers truncates without totalCount/hasMore. find_type_consumers(limit=3) → {count:3, items:[…]} with no totalCount/hasMore; 34 files exist.
acceptance: limit=3 on a 34-file type returns totalCount 34, hasMore true
findings.suggested_approach: Add totalCount/hasMore to find_type_consumers — truncation at limit is invisible, unlike the other reference tools.

findings.title: workspace_changes lists reverted/rolled-back applies as applied
findings.description: workspace_changes lists reverted/rolled-back applies as applied. seq 7/28/33 rolled back and 31/35/36 reverted are listed as plain applies; mixed path separators. validate_workspace(changedFilePaths=null) auto-scope lists G4Fixture.cs/G4CacheStore.cs/G4Triangle.cs twice (backslash vs forward-slash) — ChangeTracker stores unnormalized paths; validate_recent_git_changes has no dupes.
acceptance: Entries reverted by revert_last_apply/revert_apply_by_sequence show status=reverted
apply_with_verify rollbacks show status=rolled_back
Path separators normalized
validate_workspace auto-scoped changedFilePaths has no separator-only duplicates
findings.suggested_approach: Record revert and rollback outcomes in workspace_changes — add a status per entry so reverted and apply_with_verify rollbacks are distinguishable.

findings.title: bulk_replace_type_preview adds a using for the enclosing namespace
findings.description: bulk_replace_type_preview adds a using for the enclosing namespace. bulk_replace_type_preview adds 'using SampleLib;' inside namespace SampleLib.
acceptance: No 'using SampleLib;' added inside namespace SampleLib
findings.suggested_approach: Skip redundant usings in bulk_replace_type_preview — EnsureUsingDirective should ignore namespaces already in scope via the enclosing namespace.

findings.title: Refactor previews leave trivia defects
findings.description: Refactor previews leave trivia defects. 'class G4Fixture\n : IG4Fixture'; dead-code removal leaves a '    ' line.
acceptance: extract_interface keeps 'class G4Fixture : IG4Fixture' on one line
remove_dead_code leaves no whitespace-only line
findings.suggested_approach: Fix trivia nits in extract_interface and remove_dead_code previews — no newline before ' : IFoo', no whitespace-only residue line after removal.

findings.title: set_editorconfig_option adds a new [*.{cs,csx,cake}] section beside an existing [*.cs]
findings.description: set_editorconfig_option adds a new [*.{cs,csx,cake}] section beside an existing [*.cs]. set_editorconfig_option added [*.{cs,csx,cake}] next to the existing [*.cs] section (Phase 6/7). Related prior #735 (duplicate key) — no duplicate key this run.
acceptance: Setting a C# key on a file with [*.cs] edits that section
get_editorconfig_options reflects the value
findings.suggested_approach: Reuse an existing matching section in set_editorconfig_option — write into [*.cs] when it exists instead of appending a parallel glob section.

findings.title: scaffold_type_apply writes mixed CRLF/LF line endings
findings.description: scaffold_type_apply writes mixed CRLF/LF line endings. scaffold_type_apply → G6Widget.cs LF lines with 2 CRLF blank separators.
acceptance: Scaffolded file has a single EOL style matching .editorconfig end_of_line
findings.suggested_approach: Use one newline convention in TypeScaffolder stub assembly — AppendLine after stubs that already end in \n mixes CRLF into LF files.

findings.title: New files written via TryApplyChanges get a BOM regardless of .editorconfig
findings.description: New files written via TryApplyChanges get a BOM regardless of .editorconfig. move_type_to_file_apply → EF BB BF + CRLF with .editorconfig end_of_line=lf charset=utf-8; apply_composite writes no BOM but CRLF. Distinct from composite-apply-encoding-hygiene-consolidated (test/doc hygiene).
acceptance: create_file_apply / move_type_to_file_apply / scaffold_*_apply honor .editorconfig charset and end_of_line
All apply paths agree on encoding
findings.suggested_approach: Route new-file writes through SourceFileEncoding's no-BOM default — create_file/move_type_to_file/scaffold applies add a BOM despite charset=utf-8.

findings.title: move_type_to_project_preview always adds a source→target reference
findings.description: move_type_to_project_preview always adds a source→target reference. move_type_to_project_preview(TrulyUnusedConcreteType → SampleApp) → InvalidOperation (cycle).
acceptance: Moving an unused type to SampleApp (which references SampleLib) succeeds
Target file named after the type, not the source file (:74)
findings.suggested_approach: Add the source→target ProjectReference only when the source still uses the moved type — the unconditional reference makes moves to dependent projects always fail as cycles.

findings.title: workspace_reload leaves restoreRequired=false after a restore failure
findings.description: workspace_reload leaves restoreRequired=false after a restore failure. workspace_reload after NU1201 → workspaceErrorCount 1, isReady false, restoreRequired false, restoreHint null. Root cause not traced — confirm anchor during deepening.
acceptance: After an NU1201 restore failure, workspace_reload reports restoreRequired=true with a restoreHint
findings.suggested_approach: Set restoreRequired when project.assets.json carries restore errors — so autoRestore/restoreHint trigger after e.g. NU1201.

findings.title: manifest.json (MCPB 0.3) lists 8/174 tools and an unrunnable binary entry
findings.description: manifest.json (MCPB 0.3) lists 8/174 tools and an unrunnable binary entry. Checked field-by-field against MCPB MANIFEST.md v0.3 (no validator installed): required fields present; tools 8/174, no tools_generated; server.type binary entry_point 'RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio' not a bundled path; mcp_config.command 'roslynmcp' (global tool). Nothing packages it (docs/release-policy.md:75 'legacy DXT-style'); it ships inside the plugin payload.
acceptance: Either manifest.json is removed (and verify-version-drift / release-policy updated) or it sets tools_generated/prompts_generated true with a valid ${__dirname} command
Decision recorded in docs/release-policy.md
findings.suggested_approach: Retire or regenerate manifest.json — it lists 8 of 174 tools without tools_generated, declares no prompts, and its binary entry_point/command would not run as a bundle.

findings.title: ConsumerAnalysisService breaks on cancellation and returns partial results
findings.description: ConsumerAnalysisService breaks on cancellation and returns partial results. Code read during Phase 3 (bad-code sighting, Directive #3).
acceptance: Cancellation surfaces as OperationCanceledException / cancelled envelope, never a partial success
findings.suggested_approach: Throw on cancellation in ConsumerAnalysisService — `if (ct.IsCancellationRequested) break;` returns a truncated consumer list as if complete.

findings.title: SideEffectClassifier comments no longer match the code
findings.description: SideEffectClassifier comments no longer match the code. Code read during Phase 3 (bad-code sighting, Directive #3).
acceptance: Comments at :78 and :82 describe current behavior
findings.suggested_approach: Refresh stale comments in SideEffectClassifier — lines 78/82 describe behavior the classifier no longer has.

findings.title: Stale duplicate sample tree at repo root
findings.description: Stale duplicate sample tree at repo root. git ls-files → 19 tracked files last changed in 157fdded (1.14.0); root Program.cs differs from samples/SampleSolution copy; no eng/.github/justfile references; 2026-08-25 logging audit run2 stdout shows 2 candidate solutions (RoslynMcp.slnx, SampleSolution.slnx).
acceptance: Root SampleApp/, SampleLib/, SampleLib.Tests/, SampleSolution.slnx removed (19 tracked files)
Workspace auto-discovery at the repo root finds only RoslynMcp.slnx
Full test suite still passes (tests use samples/SampleSolution copies)
findings.suggested_approach: Remove the stale root-level SampleSolution tree — SampleApp/, SampleLib/, SampleLib.Tests/ and SampleSolution.slnx duplicate samples/SampleSolution and make workspace auto-discovery see two candidate solutions.

findings.title: SharedExpressionProbe fixture comment is stale
findings.description: SharedExpressionProbe fixture comment is stale. Phase 6k runner read (bad-code sighting, Directive #3).
acceptance: Fixture comment describes the current extract_shared_expression_to_helper probe shape
findings.suggested_approach: Refresh the stale comment in the SharedExpressionProbe fixture — it no longer describes what the fixture exercises.

findings.title: NotFound closestMatches ranks anonymous-type members above the real symbol
findings.description: NotFound closestMatches ranks anonymous-type members above the real symbol. closestMatches = <>f__AnonymousType0.i/.p/.r, <>f__AnonymousType1.m/.n; real type absent. query.Contains(simpleName) scores 1-char names; ordinal tiebreak (:254) sorts <>f__ first. 7.8 s cold.
acceptance: find_references(metadataName=RoslynMcp.Core.Services.IWorkspaceManager) suggests RoslynMcp.Roslyn.Contracts.IWorkspaceManager first
Compiler-generated symbols excluded from suggestions
findings.suggested_approach: Rank closestMatches by name similarity, not raw substring — a wrong-namespace metadataName suggests <>f__AnonymousType props instead of the real type.

findings.title: test_run with a filter matching zero tests reports success silently
findings.description: test_run with a filter matching zero tests reports success silently. test_run(filter=NoMatch, compact) → total 0, succeeded true, no warning.
acceptance: test_run(filter matching nothing) returns a warning (or distinct status) naming the filter
findings.suggested_approach: Warn when a test_run filter matches zero tests — total=0/succeeded=true hides a typo'd filter; mirror validate_*'s test-zero-run verdict.

findings.title: Alias deprecation metadata says removal in major 2 on a 4.x server
findings.description: Alias deprecation metadata says removal in major 2 on a 4.x server. get_test_coverage_map deprecation.earliestRemovalMajor=2; server 4.2.1.
acceptance: earliestRemovalMajor is a future major (or the aliases are removed per policy)
A test asserts earliestRemovalMajor > current major
findings.suggested_approach: Refresh alias deprecation metadata — get_test_coverage_map/get_symbol_outline/find_duplicated_code advertise earliestRemovalMajor 2 while the server is 4.2.1.

findings.title: revert_apply_by_sequence cannot tell already-reverted from unknown
findings.description: revert_apply_by_sequence cannot tell already-reverted from unknown. revert_apply_by_sequence(60) twice → 2nd: reason=unknown-sequence "Either the sequence is from before this session, or the apply did not produce a revertable snapshot".
acceptance: revert_apply_by_sequence on a reverted seq returns reason=already-reverted
findings.suggested_approach: Report already-reverted sequences distinctly in revert_apply_by_sequence — both cases return unknown-sequence with a misleading "before this session" message.

findings.title: Status-family tools drop _meta from structuredContent
findings.description: Status-family tools drop _meta from structuredContent. Registered client shows no _meta for workspace_list, workspace_status, server_info, server_heartbeat, workspace_health, workspace_drift_check (structuredContent channel, UseStructuredContent=true).
acceptance: workspace_status/workspace_list/server_info structuredContent carry _meta (or outputSchema documents where it is)
findings.suggested_approach: Include _meta timing in structuredContent for the 8 outputSchema tools — clients rendering structuredContent see no elapsedMs for workspace_status, server_info and siblings.

findings.title: test_reference_map denominator includes compiler-synthesized members
findings.description: test_reference_map denominator includes compiler-synthesized members. test_reference_map(W_RW) → covered 6 / uncovered 148 (3.9%), uncovered includes AnimalRecord.<Clone>$(), PrintMembers, Cat.Cat(), IAnimal.Speak().

findings.title: Symbol locator silently accepts mixed/partial locator input
